notes.title: TOEWR LE FENCE IS REVAMPING!
notes.content:
Hey guys, to a recent vote, I will be doing a revamp of the game so that it is 2D instead of 3D!

==================

Why am I doing this:

For a couple of reasons. The first reason being that 2D is much easier to work with than 3D. Because this game already looks 2D enough, why not just make it 2D instead? Another reason is that I have an art person now! Thanks, Snappy#2190! I warmly welcome you to the development team! With that, the revamped version of the game will look so much better, no more 3-year-old designs!

==================

What will be changed/added:

- User interface. So basically, buttons, text, basically the aesthetics. (MAJOR)

- Some new content. I am planning on adding different game modes, and maybe levels!

- Other reworked small thinamajiggies that I can't think of rn

- A game intro inspired by [url=https://ninja-muffin24.itch.io/funkin]Friday Night Funkin'[/url]! 

==================

How long will this take me?

Most likely August/September this year. [b]I CANNOT MAKE ANY PROMISES. I DO NOT KNOW FOR SURE![/b]

Edit:
[b]DO NOT EXPECT ANY UPDATES FOR THIS GAME DURING THE REVAMPING PROCESS![/b]

notes.title: Update 4.0
notes.content:
4.0 update!111111!!!!!

This update brings a major feature. That is the ability to save your progress! No more starting from wave 1! None of that! Blech!

To save your progress, simply start a new game, play however long as you desire, and press "Save and Quit" from the pause menu (accessed by pressing ESC)!

Another update will be coming in a bit that brings a few new enemies/towers!

Enjoy!
